_about: Pages that never show the right-hand Google ads (an article's address covers all its pages): adult or very profane content, which Google's publisher policies restrict. Reasons are for the record. Ads show only on issue covers and article pages, at 976px and wider, once web/src/config.ts has the AdSense IDs.
